name: Map playable boundary, stable zoom and suppressed hover

steps._note: NOT RUN; user owns game. Open the installed map at 1920x1080 and 5120x1440 with current UI scale. Zoom out to show the whole playable rectangle. Confirm a crisp purple border, solid black exterior and unchanged explored terrain/fog inside. Pan so each world edge intersects each viewport edge; no black should cover interior terrain.

Wheel and Shift-wheel repeatedly through detailed/overview and atlas power-of-two levels; reverse quickly. Drag the slider across its full range and release outside. Use controller triggers. Terrain must remain stable during rebuild, without empty/progressive flashes or terrain/pin misalignment. Test normal and static map modes, close/reopen and a different viewport size.

Hover a cleared/discovered POI so its card is visible, then zoom with wheel, Shift-wheel, triggers and slider. It must disappear during interaction/easing and return only after settled hover. Repeat while panning, including holding a drag still. Verify normal settled tooltips and waypoint/context actions remain available.

With normal authorized debug permissions, Ctrl-click/right-click the slider background/track/thumb, drag off it and release over the map. No teleport, outside-world notice, marker selection, context popup or map pan should result. A separate intentional Ctrl-click inside the playable border must still use native teleport permissions/safety. An intentional outside-border teleport remains rejected. No automated control or teleport in this scenario.
